class.name: OcgSelect3dSensitivepoly
class.brief_description: Sensitive Entity to make a face selectable. In some cases this class can raise Standard_ConstructionError and Standard_OutOfRange exceptions from its member Select3D_PointData myPolyg.
class.description: ! Sensitive Entity to make a face selectable. ! In some cases this class can raise Standard_ConstructionError and ! Standard_OutOfRange exceptions from its member Select3D_PointData ! myPolyg.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Constructs a sensitive face object defined by the owner OwnerId, the array of points ThePoints, and the sensitivity type Sensitivity. The array of points is the outer polygon of the geometric face.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs a sensitive face object defined by the owner OwnerId, the array of points ThePoints, and the sensitivity type Sensitivity. The array of points is the outer polygon of the geometric face.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs a sensitive curve or arc object defined by the owner theOwnerId, the theIsBVHEnabled flag, and the maximum number of points on the curve: theNbPnts.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Constructs the sensitive arc object defined by the owner theOwnerId, the circle theCircle, the parameters theU1 and theU2, the boolean theIsFilled and the number of points theNbPnts. theU1 and theU2 define the first and last points of the arc on theCircle.

method.name: NbSubElements
method.description: Returns the amount of segments in poly

method.name: Points3D
method.description: Returns the 3D points of the array used at construction time.

method.name: CenterOfGeometry
method.description: Returns center of the point set. If location transformation is set, it will be applied

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the amount of segments of the poly

method.name: Center
method.description: Returns geometry center of sensitive entity index theIdx in the vector along the given axis theAxis

method.name: Swap
method.description: Swaps items with indexes theIdx1 and theIdx2 in the vector

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
